works.title: Third Brain AI System
works.description: A multi-agent AI system architecture running on Mac Studio with dual 70B models configured as cognitive hemispheres (creative/expansive vs. logical/reductive), specialist agents for targeted domains, a coordinator agent managing task orchestration and information flow, and an incognito-processing sidebar. Simulates human brain structure and function to achieve 100-1000x cognitive amplification.
works.quote: I am working on AI agent team coordination. I have a Mac Studio with 128GB of combined RAM that will allow me to run two 70B large language models in memory simultaneously with room for computation and other LLMs to assist.

works.title: Book on Assisted Human Intelligence
works.description: A comprehensive book documenting the OR/Ora system architecture, covering RAG-based retrieval design, stateless pipeline processing, context management across tool calls, RAG provenance systems, model coordination strategy, and personal knowledge management system design built on atomic notes. 100,000+ word outline with chapters 1-14 fully vetted; book development runs parallel with system development.
works.quote: I couldn't have developed the system without writing the book, and I certainly couldn't have written the book without developing the system. The book forced clarity and gave me something to discuss with Claude that I wouldn't have gotten any other way.
